# DawnDesk

> DawnDesk is a desktop productivity suite for projects, notes, prompts, creative editing, documentation, and support workflows.

Official site: https://dawndesk.app

## Main Pages

- Home: https://dawndesk.app/
- Workspaces: https://dawndesk.app/workspaces
- Documentation: https://dawndesk.app/documentation
- Releases: https://dawndesk.app/releases
- Blog: https://dawndesk.app/blog
- FAQ: https://dawndesk.app/faq
- Contact: https://dawndesk.app/contact-us

## Product Areas

- Project and task workflow management
- Notes and documentation
- AI prompt management
- Photo and video editing workspaces
- Developer and support workflows

- Report a bug: https://dawndesk.app/report-a-bug
- Request a feature: https://dawndesk.app/request-a-feature
